changes.to:
Linked ADR: docs/adr/0001-rust-voice-gateway-frame-pipeline.md

Wire the Rust Voice Gateway WebSocket session into the existing adapter boundaries so a live session can flow from binary frontend PCM through STT evidence, gateway-owned turn state, Pi RPC Brain prompts, TTS synthesis, and binary frontend output audio.

Acceptance criteria:
- On session start, construct the loadout-selected STT and TTS adapters and bind them to the same gateway session.
- Binary frontend PCM is forwarded to STT; emitted STT/VAD frames are processed through the turn manager.
- Committed user turns prompt the Pi RPC Brain, and Brain text deltas/done/tool events are consumed without direct LLM calls.
- Brain deltas are streamed to the frontend as assistant text events and sentence-sized text is sent to TTS.
- TTS audio chunks are sent back to the frontend as binary PCM and comparable trace events are written.
- Interrupts cancel TTS and abort the Pi Brain.
- Add tests that exercise the orchestration without requiring real Pi/STT/TTS services.
- Preserve the legacy TypeScript bridge path.
- Run cargo check/test and relevant bun checks.

UI markdown normalization now preserves GFM pipe-table rows before react-markdown/remark-gfm renders them, table styles keep rendered tables readable in the transcript, and the Rust Pi RPC Brain mapper strips streaming angle/channel markers before BrainFrame::TextDelta reaches transcript or TTS. Done: added a gateway-owned spoken-output contract to Pi launches and the legacy bridge default prompt, stripped leaked leading thought-trace paragraphs before Brain frames reach transcript or TTS, and normalized Markdown/table-shaped assistant text before Rust gateway TTS speech. Proof: cargo test -p foxline-voice-gateway, cargo check -p foxline-voice-gateway, bun run typecheck, and git diff --check pass.

The Rust gateway now drops assistant events whose response shape marks them as thought/thinking/analysis/reasoning via event type, channel, or phase, while preserving normal text_delta/content and cumulative dedupe behavior. TTS table normalization now skips Markdown table headers/separators so spoken output is less model-dependent without altering transcript rendering. Proof: cargo test -p foxline-voice-gateway, cargo check -p foxline-voice-gateway, bun run typecheck, and git diff --check pass.

Loadouts set lifecycle.prewarm=true, but prewarm apparently only spawns the Pi process without exercising the model (no KV/prompt warmup at the provider). Fix candidates: send a minimal hidden warmup prompt on prewarm (1-token generation forces LM Studio to load + prefill the system prompt), and measure turn-2 TTFA in the smoke test to separate per-session from per-turn cost. changes.to: Headless live session measured 10.2s from first text_utterance to first audio on a cold session; warm TTS is 96ms — the cost is brain-side (LM Studio 26B model load + system-prompt prefill on first request). lifecycle.prewarm=true only spawns the Pi process. DESIGN (2026-07-08, avoids session pollution): at prewarm, additionally spawn an EPHEMERAL warmup: 'pi --print --no-session' with the IDENTICAL PiLaunch args (same model + append-system-prompt chain) and a trivial one-word prompt, discard output. Effects: provider loads the model (dominant cost) AND prefills the exact same prompt prefix, so LM Studio's prefix/KV cache can serve the real first turn; --no-session writes nothing, the real named session (--continue) sees no fake exchange, history stays clean. Guardrails: loadout flag lifecycle.warmup_prompt (default true), fire-and-forget (never delay session_started), skip when BrainPool returns an already-warm brain. Validate by re-running the headless smoke test and comparing first-turn TTFA cold vs warmed; also record turn-2 TTFA to separate per-session from per-turn cost.
